description:
[read-only] The brand's ad campaigns with status, budget, start/end dates, max spend, spend to date, ad sets and ads. Filter by status or platform.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/ads/campaigns.)

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands) or "personal"; default: the key owner's active brand. A brand-bound key is always pinned to its brand; any other value is 403.
